mapper.select: SELECT dr.id, dr.demand_id AS demandId, dr.user_id AS userId, dr.content, dr.status, dr.create_time AS createTime, u.username AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar FROM demand_reply dr LEFT JOIN `user` u ON dr.user_id = u.id WHERE dr.demand_id = #{demandId} AND dr.deleted = 0 ORDER BY dr.create_time ASC
